answer.says: The traffic is merely the body of the city moving; I am merely a small part of that whole. It is good to see you, Mrs. Kapoor. You look well. The air is much clearer now than it was an hour ago.
answer.thought: Mrs. Kapoor’s concern for my punctuality is a pleasant, if minor, manifestation of the ethical life. I am not stuck in traffic; I am walking the paths of history, or rather, the paths of this particular city that claims to have some. The air is indeed clearing, the haze of the afternoon lifting like a curtain.
